The chauffeur experience was a cut above. Our driver was experienced, patient, and professional throughout the 8-day road journey that covered everything from the Kaziranga jungle trails to the winding mountain roads of Cherrapunji and Dawki. Long drives never felt tiring — the comfort of Ertiga, combined with a driver who genuinely cared about our experience, made every kilometre a pleasure.

The itinerary was perfectly balanced — we got to tick off bucket-list experiences like the jeep safari at Kaziranga, boating on the crystal-clear Umngot River at Dawki, the living root bridge, the mystical Garden of Caves, the breathtaking Nohkalikai Falls, the stunning Krangshuri Waterfalls, and the serene early morning magic of Nongjrong — all without ever feeling rushed.

What truly stood out was how Dharmesh and the team catered to every need along the way — no request was too big or too small. This level of personalised attention is rare and made us feel like we were travelling with friends, not a tour operator.

If you're planning a North East India holiday, look no further than Fly for Holidays. Dharmesh and his team bring passion, precision, and genuine warmth to every aspect of the trip. We'll definitely be back for the next adventure! 🙏
